outline: 透過原理解說與系統實作，使學生熟悉物件導向設計原理及C++進階程式設計技術，內容含：1. C++ 物件模型 2. 類別與物件3. 建構者與解構者 4. 繼承 5. 虛擬函式與多型 6. 運算子溢載 7. 例外處理 8. 泛型程式設計 9. 標準模板程式庫 10. 期末專題設計
schedule:
01 介紹 C++ 開發環境與作業繳交方式; Unit testing with GoogleTest
02 How to solve it (HTSI) - Example: applying how to solve it (math vector in C)
03 Inner product round 1/Inner product round 2
04 Inner product, round 3
05 Handling I/O; inner product, round 4: refactoring into object
06 Midterm 1: Lab test 1 （上機考試：科研1223）
07 Special member functions: default constructor, copy constructor,
destructor, shallow copy, and deep copy
08 AI coding with HTSI
09 Convex polygon; Special member functions: copy assignment operator overloading; return a reference to a data member; encapsulation and delegation: How do ConvexPolygon and Vector collaborate?
10 Delegation from ConvexPolygon to Vector Sorting Vectors with STL sort; Sorting Vertices of  a convex polygon;
11  Midterm 2: Lab test 2 （上機考試：科研1223）
12 Simple Factory vs constructor for Convex Polygon; Polymorphism
13 Design: Overloading vs. overriding vs. template
14 Programming with STL
15 File i/o; stream
16 Final: Lab test 3 （上機考試：科研1223）
